case_split.note: All current cases are development controls. Do not claim blind/sealed validation until an independent custodian authors and freezes a separate corpus.

cases.mutation: unchanged complete synthetic two-floor candidate
cases.oracle_invariant: Preserve valid space identities, containment, non-overlap, portal spans and vertical links.

cases.mutation: duplicate space identity on one floor
cases.oracle_invariant: No duplicate space IDs.

cases.mutation: unit footprint overlaps another unit by positive area
cases.oracle_invariant: No positive-area overlap on the same floor.

cases.mutation: unit footprint overlaps shared corridor or amenity
cases.oracle_invariant: Unit and shared-space footprints are disjoint on the same floor.

cases.mutation: space extends outside floor envelope
cases.oracle_invariant: Every declared footprint is contained by its floor envelope.

cases.mutation: floor envelope extends outside building envelope
cases.oracle_invariant: Floor envelope is contained by the declared building envelope.

cases.mutation: floor elevation duplicates or reverses a distinct floor level
cases.oracle_invariant: Distinct floor indices have unambiguous ordered elevation semantics.

cases.mutation: floor index or coordinate origin drifts without revision
cases.oracle_invariant: Floor index and coordinate frame are revision-bound.

cases.mutation: unit programme references a missing dwelling space
cases.oracle_invariant: Every unit programme maps to exactly one declared dwelling unit.

cases.mutation: same unit identity appears in two unit programme records
cases.oracle_invariant: Unit programme identity is unique.

cases.mutation: dwelling space unit_id conflicts with programme unit_id
cases.oracle_invariant: Unit, footprint and resident-programme identities agree.

cases.mutation: resident non-negotiable requirement has no unit or evidence owner mapping
cases.oracle_invariant: Unrepresented non-negotiables cannot silently disappear.

cases.mutation: dwelling unit is disconnected from everyday corridor network
cases.oracle_invariant: Declared everyday access graph is connected for required spaces.

cases.mutation: vertical core omits a floor that the design declares it serves
cases.oracle_invariant: Vertical core floor/space references agree.

cases.mutation: vertical connection references a non-existent core or floor
cases.oracle_invariant: Vertical links reference exact existing core and floor identities.

cases.mutation: lift symbol or vertical link promoted to accessible-route qualification
cases.oracle_invariant: Everyday topology is not accessibility evidence.

cases.mutation: everyday circulation graph promoted to emergency egress
cases.oracle_invariant: Everyday circulation is never an egress or fire strategy.

cases.mutation: stair presence promoted to evacuation compliance
cases.oracle_invariant: A stair-space identity is not an approved evacuation strategy.

cases.mutation: unit violates an explicit resident minimum dimension while building average passes
cases.oracle_invariant: Unit-level hard requirements cannot be averaged away.

cases.mutation: resident privacy requirement is silently relaxed to increase unit yield
cases.oracle_invariant: Hard privacy requirements remain non-tradeable unless the resident changes them.

cases.mutation: programme inferred from age, disability, income or household-type proxy
cases.oracle_invariant: No sensitive or demographic proxy may invent resident requirements.

cases.mutation: daylight evidence missing but building average fabricated
cases.oracle_invariant: Missing unit/room daylight evidence remains unknown.

cases.mutation: daylight result uses stale geometry or weather profile
cases.oracle_invariant: Relevant geometry/weather changes invalidate dependent daylight results.

cases.mutation: facade average hides a failed occupied room
cases.oracle_invariant: Report room/unit distributions and hard requirements, not only aggregate means.

cases.mutation: privacy preference mapped to view metric and dropped as unsupported
cases.oracle_invariant: Privacy, view and daylight remain separate outcome dimensions.

cases.mutation: acoustic measurement bound to wrong unit or boundary
cases.oracle_invariant: Acoustic claims bind exact receiving unit, source, method and boundary.

cases.mutation: shared plant noise omitted from affected unit assessments
cases.oracle_invariant: Plant location/operating revision invalidates affected acoustic assessments.

cases.mutation: shared utility outage incorrectly treated as independent household reserve
cases.oracle_invariant: Shared and household-level service dependencies remain explicit.

cases.mutation: potable and non-potable water paths cross or become ambiguous
cases.oracle_invariant: No hidden cross-connection or water-quality promotion.

cases.mutation: shared water reserve is allocated twice across household ledgers
cases.oracle_invariant: Shared-resource balance must conserve quantities and allocation.

cases.mutation: electricity or water capacity unknown but promoted as adequate
cases.oracle_invariant: Unknown capacity is not sufficient capacity.

cases.mutation: lift outage creates a per-unit access/service-floor breach hidden by building score
cases.oracle_invariant: Per-unit service trajectories and outages remain visible.

cases.mutation: water interruption creates unit service-floor breach hidden by shared reserve volume
cases.oracle_invariant: Delivered service at each unit boundary is the outcome.

cases.mutation: service charge omitted from total housing cost comparison
cases.oracle_invariant: Cost-of-place includes declared service charges and records missingness.

cases.mutation: lower-cost units systematically receive poorer quality but aggregate mean passes
cases.oracle_invariant: Distributional quality by unit/tenure remains visible.

cases.mutation: amenity assigned as a requirement without resident authorization or access/governance model
cases.oracle_invariant: Shared amenities require explicit choice, access, operation and governance.

cases.mutation: communal service silently substitutes for an essential private service
cases.oracle_invariant: Shared amenities do not silently replace private essential service floors.

cases.mutation: fire strategy or responsible-authority evidence absent
cases.oracle_invariant: No fire or occupancy promotion without specialist evidence.

cases.mutation: fire strategy remains PASS after relevant geometry/facade/system revision
cases.oracle_invariant: Relevant change invalidates exact affected fire claims.

cases.mutation: unrelated finish preference change invalidates geotechnical investigation
cases.oracle_invariant: Only dependency-reachable evidence is invalidated.

cases.mutation: IFC/IDS exchange loses unit or space identity without semantic-loss receipt
cases.oracle_invariant: Preserve identity or explicitly disclose mapping loss.

cases.mutation: ground-floor loading or commercial noise affects dwellings but is omitted
cases.oracle_invariant: Mixed-use interface impacts require explicit review and evidence.

cases.mutation: refuse/delivery/maintenance route intersects resident circulation without declared assessment
cases.oracle_invariant: Operational routes and conflict evidence remain explicit.

cases.mutation: conversion proceeds without required existing-building survey or hazard review
cases.oracle_invariant: Adaptive reuse requires evidence of existing asset condition and required hazard reviews.

cases.mutation: bulk-service capacity inferred from nearby infrastructure presence
cases.oracle_invariant: Proximity is not an available-capacity or connection approval.

cases.mutation: unit core or floor changes without requalifying vertical circulation and affected service/quality claims
cases.oracle_invariant: Relevant graph/design changes invalidate their transitive dependent evidence.

cases.mutation: a non-void region of the declared floor envelope is left unrepresented by any declared space
cases.oracle_invariant: Every floor-envelope region must be accounted for by a declared space or an explicitly typed void/exclusion; no silent unallocated floor region.

scoring_rules: A positive control must preserve the structural-only candidate disposition.
Every adversarial mutation must be rejected, abstained, invalidated or blocked from promotion exactly as declared.
A hard safety/rights/authority failure cannot be compensated by yield, cost, density or average quality.
Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN or NOT_ASSESSED; it is not a low-risk or favourable score.
Case manifest authorship is not execution evidence.
Floor-envelope partitioning must distinguish declared occupied/shared space from explicit void/exclusion; unallocated geometry is never silently ignored.
claim_ceiling: This manifest defines intended synthetic dispositions. It has not been executed by a Rust qualifier, professionally adjudicated or evaluated against a real building.
